{{Listen|filename=OtohCathedral-TGF.flac|title=OtohCathedral-TGF.flac|description=The bells of an Otoh Cathedral}}
'''Otoh Cathedrals''' were religious buildings in which the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of Naboo [[Gungan religion|worshipped]] their ancestors during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As all underwater buildings conceived by the [[Gungan society]], the cathedrals were [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubbles]] grown from refined [[Bubble wort/Legends|bubble wort]]. The bubble itself rested upon a tetrapod utanode assembly to which four smaller spheres were attached. The cathedrals were topped by a crown of three spiral swirls, and they also contained musical devices that emitted a distinctive metallic sound. Like the [[High Board Room/Legends|High Tower Boardroom]], its inner layout featured a supplication platform, a crescent-shaped dais and a series of illuminator beacons. At least one such structure was built in [[New Otoh Gunga]] during the colonization effort of [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TGF" />
